name: Stocklake
description: Stocklake connects Claude to a financial data pipeline covering 2,000+ stocks. Get real-time prices, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, and 52-week ranges alongside AI-synthesized research summaries, sentiment analysis from SEC Form 4 filings and institutional holdings, sector rotation signals, macro regime assessments, and AI-screened discovery ideas. The pipeline refreshes continuously via market data feeds, news ingestion, and nightly AI analysis — giving Claude a complete picture of any publicly traded stock without requiring multiple data sources.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Stocklake to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Stocklake to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.stocklake.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Stocklake MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stocklake lists 20 MCP tools, including get_stock, get_stock_news, get_stock_history, get_earnings_calendar, get_market_assessment, get_sector_intelligence, get_sentiment_profile, search_stocks, get_stock_rating, get_stocks, get_market_pulse, and get_stock_ai_summary.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Stocklake?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Stocklake in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Stocklake requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Stocklake is developed by Stocklake. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
